# Fargo Data & AI

> An informal community in the Fargo–Moorhead–West Fargo area (North Dakota / Minnesota) that meets to share ideas, discuss data and AI trends and tools, and enjoy member-led presentations in a relaxed, welcoming setting.

Website: https://www.fargodataandai.com/

## What we do
- Host in-person meetups with member-led presentations on data and AI.
- Run a Slack community for questions, links, show-and-tell, and job leads.
- Send one short email every month.

## Key pages
- [Home, upcoming events, and how to join](https://www.fargodataandai.com/): the upcoming meetup list, the Slack invite, and the email signup, all on one page.

## Notes
- Upcoming events change often. The home page is the source of truth for dates, times, and locations.
- To join the community, use the Slack invite or the email signup on the home page.
